project.name: 群星 Star 前端
project.styleDefinitionBrief: Deep space command center UI — dark navy backgrounds (#0a0e27), starlight gold (#ffd700) accent, cosmic dashboard aesthetic with glowing elements, monospace data displays, sci-fi mission control vibe.

pages.title: 星图面板
pages.description: Agent discovery dashboard — real-time star field showing all detected AI Agent processes with status indicators, filters by type, and quick actions.

pages.title: 星轨控制台
pages.description: Task creation and queue management — nova creation form, priority selection, orbit queue with drag-reorder, launch/adjust/fade controls.

pages.title: 星辉审查
pages.description: Results review and echo management — starlight output stream, gaze history timeline, echo feedback panel, constellation overview.
